analysis: The change is documentation-only: docs/architecture/inference.md, with no code, config or endpoint changes. Both supplied units are head-side text for lines 402-1207. Of the changed head ranges (25-171 and 868-869), only 868-869 fall in these units. That edit, in the 'Chat-template render check' section, says multimodal render fixtures run only when the shared media discovery policy accepts the configuration, with a pointer to model-registry.md. It makes no new security claim. It narrows when fixtures run and does not weaken any control. The rest of the supplied text is unchanged context. It mentions the prefix-cache SSD checkpoint store, deadline guards, MTP, MiMo and Qwen4 ownership, and media caps, but I saw no change to cache TTL, HMAC lookup tags, salt scoping or the at-rest design. I therefore see no regression against T-041, SEC-035 or the TB-007 and TB-003 assumptions. Coverage limit: the head lines 25-171 describing the new unregistered NemotronSuperLocalBridgeBuilder and NemotronSuperLocalBinding paths (pretokenized text only, media, tools and client prompt-cache keys rejected, text prefix reuse only with a checkpoint bank) are not in these units, and no source files changed. If a later pass reviews them, check that the docs' claims about prefix-cache reuse and rejected client cache keys stay consistent with T-041 (coordinator-authored cacheSalt, with caller prompt_cache_key ignored) and do not imply a new at-rest tier or routing surface.
